verdict: Post-deployment verification is not a clean release sign-off. Many originally missing capabilities now pass. Remaining confirmed application findings, corrected test issues, and incomplete/manual verification are separated below. The executed test register gives the final result and evidence for each rerun; visibility-only checks do not close an entire release claim.
methodology: Only evidence captured after the user's deployment confirmation on 24 October 2026 contributes to this assessment. The 21 October pre-deployment spot checks are excluded.

Production tests used the configured disposable QA account and Nexstock QA Company. Billing and POS actions are synthetic record-only transactions, not payment-gateway charges. No real customer email dispatch, deployment command, migration, credential change or physical printing was performed.
A pass certifies the executed assertions, not every variation of a feature. Setup/cleanup and the 67 local safety checks are reported separately from feature coverage.
Initial probes stopped on common adapter failures. Corrected cases were rerun. An earlier stopped probe is not an intentionally skipped final test, and its raw failure count is not a bug count.

Independent read-only suites used isolated artifact directories. Company settings and billing changes were verified with restoration checks. Duplicate failures from one capability are grouped into one finding.

Deferred PIN locking and branch registers are excluded by the feature release's explicit scope. Browser emulation does not certify USB/Bluetooth devices, physical printers, mobile apps, backend hashing or cross-business isolation.
environment: Target: https://nexstock.stylotech.mu/app | Production | Nexstock QA Company | Test date: 24 October 2026 (Indian/Mauritius).

Automation: Playwright 1.62.1, Chromium, Windows. Initial null-viewport headless attempts used the browser default; later desktop retests used a fixed 1920 x 1080 viewport. Headed runs retain maximized windows.

Deployment was confirmed by the user. No deployment-matched commit/build evidence was supplied, so branch identity, migrations and worker restart are not independently certified from UI behaviour alone.

caseRules.meaning: Observed configured-period behaviour only. The user's approval of negative overdue days does not establish that configured payment terms and an overdue counter are the same field. Not a policy pass or a confirmed bug.

caseRules.match: finds and links an existing customer|searches, builds an order
caseRules.meaning: RET-001: an active QA customer is available in Customers but missing from the POS selector. Integrated checkout is blocked at customer selection.

caseRules.match: exports a valid PDF|includes configured banking|Net 30 tax invoice
caseRules.meaning: RET-002: invoice export opens the public site's 404 page because its generated URL omits /app. PDF contents and the export endpoint of the full flow cannot be certified.
RET-003: the customization footer/Add to Order is outside the viewport and cannot be reached by normal click/scroll at 1920 x 1080. No force click was used.
RET-004: the active positive control appears, but the explicitly deactivated QA vendor also remains selectable. No purchase order was submitted.

caseRules.match: marks an issued unpaid invoice overdue
caseRules.meaning: OBS-001: a persisted past-due invoice remains Pending in the list. Confirm the required list/status/filter policy before treating the label itself as a confirmed defect; customer ageing is evaluated separately.

limits.meaning: Parent selector/options only; this case does not create a three-level tree or attempt a cycle.
Tag control availability only; assignment, saved grouping and filtering need deeper verification.
Available classes follow the configured company rate. Controlled 15% arithmetic is tested in POS and billing separately; product zero-rated calculation is not certified by this selector check.
Available modes only. The separate persistence case verifies an inclusive override, not every mixed-rate line combination.
PNG upload and reopened Edit image verified. Do not infer every format, list thumbnail, POS photo and removal variation from this case alone.
Archive, archived view and restore verified; preservation of a pre-existing sold-invoice relation is not established by a newly created unsold product.
The executed scenario applies a percentage line discount. Fixed line discount and clamping need separate arithmetic checks.
Unsaved template-width preview plus receipt print invocation only. No physical width, native print dialog, saved printer transport or actual paper output certification.
Public UI/synthetic feedback or untouched controls only. No account was registered; reset delivery, password rotation, server-side policy and mobile parity require an isolated human-assisted account.

limits.match: keyboard HID|scan bursts|manual product click|manual keyboard search
limits.meaning: Browser keyboard/cart emulation on the selected simple/service QA fixture. Basic-variant dialog reachability is a separate failing check; physical HID devices are not certified.
Credit-limit persistence verified. Non-zero AP bill balance and over-limit warning remain unverified; order blocking is explicitly not required by this release.

rows.detail: Valid synthetic invoices now save and survive reload; paid save, dates and controlled 15% totals were exercised. This does not certify every document type using the shared store assignment.
A synthetic draft quotation saves, survives reload with its reference/customer/137.25 amount, labels the expiry Valid Until, and leaves stock unchanged (invoicing-4).
Due date before issue date is rejected with a date-specific message. Required customer/items/date and month-boundary terms were also rerun.

The focused AR scenario independently checks unchanged stock and zero AR for a draft, then an exact two-unit deduction when issued. These assertions passed before the separate ageing locator was corrected.
Persisted Paid status and zero remaining amount are checked; a text-concatenation regex error was corrected to assert the actual Status cell.
Saved invoice detail displays the synthetic customer's known billing address.
Separate customer BRN/VAT and saved invoice display pass. PDF identity/VAT output is blocked by RET-002; do not close PDF coverage.
Due on receipt, Net 15/30/60 month-boundary arithmetic and manual due date persistence pass. Customer-default inheritance and every date-edit variation are not independently covered.
Saved invoice header/footer can be cleared and survive reload. Exported branding remains blocked by RET-002.
Existing fixture selection by unique email works. Two customers sharing a display name were not independently exercised; add a duplicate-name fixture before closing the identity-binding claim.

Non-zero independent reconciliation passes (invoicing-5): issued invoice 200, payment 50, outstanding/1-30 days/closing balance 150; draft/cancelled 777 is excluded. Statement CSV and print invocation pass. Credit notes, all bucket boundaries/date filters and the AR report remain unverified.
Credit/debit note save, cross-business payment references, made-to-order queue and held/refunded POS atomicity need targeted fixtures/scenarios. Passing invoice save does not establish them.
Owner/admin price override and recalculated total pass. Flexible-pricing permissions for a non-admin account were not exercised.
Clear confirms, Cancel preserves and Confirm empties the order. F9 shortcut was not separately asserted.
Quick-add creates and selects a synthetic customer using the new Name/Add and select form. Existing-customer lookup still fails separately as RET-001.
Line percentage discount arithmetic passes. Fixed-amount line discount and exact line-total clamp are not fully exercised.

Negative discount does not become a surcharge; excessive percentage shows rejection/validation and does not create a negative total. Charge gating for every invalid discount representation needs a separate check.
Configured MCB Juice persists after settings reload and completes a record-only sale. Cash, Card and Bank Transfer completed too; non-cash correctly has no cash-received field.
Card/Cash split was completed and the cash change calculation checked. No gateway charge was attempted.
Controlled company VAT15 changes a 100 sale to 115; tax exemption returns it to 100. Company VAT state is restored.
Real category tiles/navigation pass. Independent UOM/supplier display binding in every POS view is not fully asserted.
A QA SKU beyond the first catalogue page is found in POS (pos-3); this checks availability beyond the old initial list, not every pagination/filter combination.

Branch-specific header/footer and inherited company VAT number appear on a completed till receipt; print invocation passes (pos-4). Service sale and No stock kept display are tested separately. Physical paper output and backend service stock-ledger auditing are not certified.
Wholesale price saves and is retained when Edit is reopened.

Service/labour type creates and persists; scanner/cart works without inventory. A completed service checkout and unchanged No stock kept marker are tested separately; this is not an independent backend stock-ledger audit.
Archive, archived view, restore and return to Active pass. Historical sold-invoice preservation needs a linked sold fixture.
Scanner selection focuses barcode input, leading first digit/zero is retained, and Enter does not submit the product form.
Parent-category options and tag assignment control exist. Hierarchy creation, cycle rejection, tag persistence/filtering are not fully covered by those availability tests.
Standard/zero-rated/exempt options exist and an Exempt edit survives full navigation. Full per-product zero/exempt/mixed-document arithmetic matrix is not covered.
Supported PNG uploads and reopened Edit image pass; SVG was an invalid test fixture. Every list/POS thumbnail and image variation is not certified.
Inclusive override persistence and mode options pass; full inclusive/exclusive VAT math across all document types still needs expansion.
Description/barcode clearing, names, prices and barcode edits pass. Category/unit/supplier reassignment and bulk Set Discontinued are not comprehensively rerun.
Independent BRN/VAT override saves and reloads, and original inheritance is restored. The full inherited-to-company-update propagation matrix is not covered.

Branch header/footer saves/reopens, appears on a completed receipt for the actual QA till branch, and invokes printing (pos-4). A baseline receipt positively identifies the till branch; physical paper is not certified.
Saved notes, SKU, signed quantity and before/after detail are retrievable; positive/negative adjustments, valuation and full flow pass with branch stock restored.
One scan adds one; 0/5/25ms cadences, leading zeros, repeated bursts, unknown input and focus/manual search pass on a simple/service fixture. Variant-dialog layout fails separately (RET-003).
No approved new/storeless QA business was available. Existing company already has five branches. Creating another licensed business may require purchase/terms and was not performed.
New and edited credit-limit values persist. Non-zero bill balance/over-limit warning need an approved AP bill fixture. Order blocking is explicitly outside this release.
BRN is separate/optional; BRN edit/clear and Tax ID independence pass. Name-only creation works with optional email.
RET-004: a deactivated supplier remains offered despite an active positive control. Separate observation: later-sorting active vendors were absent from the first loaded picker page.
Separate customer BRN/VAT persistence and clearing optional company, phone and address pass. Invoice identity is separately constrained by PDF export failure.
Company profile/email and website persist. Only the two newly real fields replaced local demo-baseline entries; original baseline was backed up before migration.
BRN and Tax ID are independent; BRN and Tax ID clearing/retention are rerun, with QA baseline restored.

Separate VAT number field exists; a controlled inherited company VAT number appears on the QA till receipt. Invoice PDF verification is blocked by RET-002; quotation PDF contents are not independently certified.
Two-decimal vs whole-amount display persists and changes POS formatting. Company inclusive-VAT preference and product inclusive override persist; broader cross-module formatting remains partial.
Light/dark reload persistence passes; System follows emulated OS dark/light and survives reload.
French navigation/settings, saved reload/route persistence, translated labels and html lang=fr pass; language is restored.
Reset to Default and Cancel were not independently scripted; actual failed-save messaging was not fault-injected. Success checks require real successful HTTP responses, not toast alone.
My Profile shows the signed-in QA account, not demo John Doe. Profile-edit persistence, session revocation and 2FA flows were not performed.

Signup synthetic feedback enforces minimum/uppercase/lowercase/number and optional symbols; strength increases to maximum with a symbol. Password-update form has a masked/empty control and meter. Actual reset/change/invitation/mobile policy requires isolated human-assisted coverage.
Unenforced company timeout/password widgets are removed. This is not a pass for inactivity PIN locking, which is explicitly deferred.
PIN lock and branch registers: not claimed delivered. Do not open new bugs merely because they remain excluded.

No statement-PDF export, no supplier-over-limit order blocking, no new-field product CSV coverage, initial product stock not persisted, held-order exemption and receipt discount/exemption presentation limitations remain declared. The known invoice-PDF currency issue is not certified fixed.
No second approved business, deployment-matched backend audit, mobile build, physical-device acceptance or isolated credential-change mailbox. Browser passes do not replace that evidence.

bugs.title: Active QA customer cannot be found in the POS customer picker
bugs.environment: Production /app/pos; Nexstock QA Company; desktop Chromium; 24 October 2026.
steps: Open Customers and search for QA POS Automation Customer (qa.pos.customer@example.invalid). Confirm its status is Active.
Open Point of Sale and open the Walk-in Customer selector.
Search for the exact existing QA customer name.
Attempt to select it for checkout.
bugs.expected: The active existing customer is returned and can be linked to the order.
bugs.actual: POS reports no matching customer, although the Customers module shows the active record. The independent linking test and integrated POS flow fail at this same step.
bugs.attachment: pos-2: customer-linking and pos-full-flow error contexts/screenshots; live Customers UI positive control inspected.
bugs.comment: One finding, not two tickets. Search/pagination/filter scope should be checked; do not create a duplicate customer as a workaround.
bugs.action: Developer: search all eligible customers by identity across pages and add a beyond-first-page active-customer regression. QA: rerun linking and the complete checkout flow after correction.

bugs.title: Invoice Download opens a public 404 page instead of the invoice export
bugs.environment: Production /app/invoicing; Nexstock QA Company; desktop Chromium; 24 October 2026.
steps: Create and save a valid synthetic invoice, or open a current-run QA billing invoice.
bugs.expected: A usable invoice PDF/print view opens for the requested document, retaining the /app application mount.
bugs.actual: The new tab navigates to /invoicing/<id> without /app and displays the marketing site's 404: That page is not here. No file download or print invocation occurs.
bugs.attachment: invoice-pdf-diagnostic.json; invoicing-4 invoice-export-popup screenshots and error contexts (including controlled invoice references).
bugs.comment: Verified through a separate read-only diagnostic as well as the scripted export. Exported invoice identity, branding and VAT contents remain blocked, not passed. Full-flow export failures share this cause.
bugs.action: Developer: generate mount-aware application URLs for print/export actions and verify both list and detail entry points. QA: rerun PDF identity, branding, VAT and full flow; inspect the produced PDF, not just a button or HTTP success.

bugs.title: Basic-variant customization footer is outside the desktop viewport
bugs.environment: Production POS; QA-FLOW-mv89ihb7-8dc11e basic Size/Color/Material variants; Chromium 1920 x 1080.
steps: Open POS and choose the in-stock QA flow product with basic variants.
Leave Standard (No Variant) selected, or inspect the available variants.
Scroll normally to reach Add to Order.
Attempt to click Add to Order without changing browser zoom or forcing the click.
bugs.expected: The customization body scrolls within a bounded dialog and the action footer remains reachable.
bugs.actual: The dialog content/variant list extends below the viewport; normal scrollIntoView and click cannot reach Add to Order even at 1920 x 1080. A larger viewport did not resolve it.
bugs.attachment: hardware-3/artifacts: release basic-variant customization failure screenshot and error context; hardware-2 also reproduces at 1920 x 1080.
bugs.comment: This concerns Phase 1 basic variants, not deferred assembly/serialized products. Scanner counting is tested separately on a simple/service fixture and passes; no force click hides the layout problem.
bugs.action: Developer: constrain dialog height, add a working internal scroll area and keep footer controls inside the visible dialog. QA: retest mouse, keyboard, scanner customization and normal desktop sizes.

bugs.title: Deactivated supplier remains selectable for a new purchase order
bugs.environment: Production /app/purchasing/orders/new; Nexstock QA Company; Chromium; 24 October 2026.
steps: Create two clearly named QA vendors: one active positive control and one intended for deactivation. Use early-sorting names so both are in the loaded picker range.
Deactivate the second vendor and confirm Inactive persists in Suppliers.
Open a new Purchase Order and its supplier picker.
Confirm the active control is offered, then search/inspect the deactivated vendor.
bugs.expected: The valid active control remains selectable; the deactivated vendor is excluded from new purchasing selection while historical records are preserved.
bugs.actual: Both vendors are offered. The active positive control passes, but the explicitly deactivated vendor is still present in the picker.
bugs.attachment: suppliers-4/artifacts: release vendor-availability error context and screenshot; journal-based cleanup retains both synthetic vendors inactive.
bugs.comment: No purchase order was submitted. An earlier probe also exposed missing later-sorting active vendors; that pagination observation is not used to manufacture a pass for exclusion.
bugs.action: Developer: align picker eligibility with the status representation written by Deactivate and exclude inactive/suspended/archived records consistently. QA: rerun with an active positive control and a vendor beyond the first loaded page.

automation.title: Deployed controls and strict locators updated
automation.actual: Archive tab, parent selector, VAT/mode dropdowns, optional supplier email, quick-add Name/Add and select form, non-cash tender and split-payment rows replaced old provisional assumptions. Paid status is asserted in its cell, not concatenated row text.

automation.title: Persisted-state and readiness checks strengthened
automation.actual: Product tax edits use fresh navigation; catalogue fixtures wait for real settings data; company VAT/branding saves wait for hydration. Product login is reused per worker to avoid valid-login rate limiting. PNG replaces unsupported SVG upload input.

automation.title: Stock detail adapter corrected
automation.actual: History now exposes View adjustment buttons, and reason cells include notes. Tests target the recorded reason text and the actual detail dialog; notes, quantities and stock restoration pass.

automation.title: Invoice lifecycle follows real controls
automation.actual: Product row selection no longer uses a combobox index shifted by Payment Terms. Change Status selects Pending/Cancelled. Partial-payment assertions use the visible Partially Paid detail and independently calculated remaining balance instead of assuming the list label changes.

automation.title: Settings baseline and request-schema migration
automation.actual: The original local baseline was preserved. Only newly persisted email/website replaced old demo placeholders after all other baseline fields matched. The guard allows only the observed unchanged four-field payment-method projection and verifies complete metadata is unchanged after each save. All 67 local safety tests pass.

automation.title: Evidence isolation and desktop viewport
automation.actual: Every attempt has separate JSON/JUnit/HTML and screenshots. Later attempts do not erase module auth/recovery ledgers. Headless desktop retests use 1920 x 1080; headed runs retain maximized windows. The variant footer defect remains reproducible and was not bypassed.

automation.title: Rate-limited probes separated from functional failures
automation.actual: Concurrent catalogue/billing probes hit the production Too many requests response. No failed mutation was automatically replayed. The catalogue full flow and variants passed on a sequential focused rerun (products-6). Zero/negative payment validation passed after accepting the actual Invalid payment amount message; AR term labels use visible text rather than an unsupported accessible name.

automation.title: Till branch and child-window print observation corrected
automation.actual: A stock-adjustment default branch is not necessarily the user's till. The receipt scenario now discovers its actual approved QA branch through a baseline receipt before editing that branch. Standard Print uses a child window, so print instrumentation covers the browser context and records calls even when the child closes. 58/80mm preview and receipt print invocation pass (pos-4). Service stock is correctly represented by No stock kept, not a numeric zero.

blockers.title: Past-due list status remains Pending
blockers.actual: A controlled invoice issued 24 September with due date 23 October remains Pending in the invoice list on 24 October. The separate AR view assigns past-due amounts to ageing buckets.
blockers.attachment: invoicing-3 invoice-lifecycle past-date failure; invoice reference 91.
blockers.action: Confirm whether Overdue is a computed list status/filter or a separate scheduled/manual transition. Verify the Overdue tab/count before logging a label-only defect. This observation is not included in the confirmed bug count.

blockers.title: Configured supplier credit days versus an overdue counter
blockers.actual: Negative-day behaviour is retained as an observation. The user's explanation permits negative days when payment is overdue; it does not unambiguously define the editable Credit Period field's semantics.
blockers.action: Confirm that distinction with product/development before classifying acceptance or rejection as a defect. No assumed negative-day bug is reported.

blockers.title: Cross-business, lifecycle and AP data gaps
blockers.actual: A second approved business, an independent AP bill/credit-warning fixture, credit/debit note matrix, held/refund atomicity and made-to-order queue scenarios were not independently established.
blockers.action: Provide approved fixture accounts/data and run those targeted scenarios before signing off the broader shared-backend claims.

blockers.title: Human-assisted security and physical-device verification
blockers.actual: Password reset/change completion, invitations, 2FA changes, real device/session revocation, backend bcrypt audit, mobile parity and physical scanner/printer acceptance are not certified by synthetic browser controls.
blockers.action: Use isolated QA mailboxes/accounts and approved human handoff for credential changes; supply deployment-matched backend/mobile evidence and physical-device acceptance records.

blockers.title: Explicitly deferred and declared limitations
blockers.actual: PIN lock and branch registers are deferred. Statement PDF, product new-field CSV, opening stock on creation and declared held/receipt limitations are not treated as newly fixed capabilities.
blockers.action: Keep these separate from regression defects and do not mark them passed or silently skipped.

cleanup: Synthetic invoices, receipts and draft quotations remain as QA evidence; no fiscal history was permanently deleted. Stock suites compensate the QA branch balances; suppliers/customers created by their suites are retained inactive.

Company tax, legal identity, language/theme and temporary receipt/branding values are checked against their captured baselines. Original baseline backups and auth state remain private and are not embedded in this PDF.

Invoice rerun cleanup restores both QA branch stock balances, original company tax and invoice header/footer. Settings cleanup, supplier/customer inactivation and hardware no-write checks passed. Final POS cleanup is recorded with its focused rerun. No commit, push, deployment or migration was requested or performed for this verification.
